dq_rule_description: Populated 20-character alphanumeric synthetic LEI; no checksum validation
Finite non-negative drawn balance within commitment tolerance; utilized exposure equals drawn
Valid maturity on or after valid origination
Facility and collateral pair exists in clean synthetic reference
Industry code belongs to configured synthetic sectors
Finite utilization in zero to one range agrees with drawn divided by commitment
Collateral type belongs to configured taxonomy
Valid origination on or before reporting date
Finite interest rate within configured limits
